body:
Fixes https://github.com/duckdblabs/duckdb-internal/issues/11173

DETACH closes the database once `use_count() == 1`. But `use_count()` is a relaxed load, so it doesn't synchronize with threads that already dropped their reference without `close_lock`, e.g. a scanner that got the database from `GetDatabases()`. TSan then reports a race between their reads (`GetCatalog()`) and `Cleanup()`.

This PR copies our reference and drops the copy right before `Close()`:
- The decrement is acq_rel, so it synchronizes with all earlier decrements of the counter.
- Dropping a copy rather than `attached_db` itself keeps the count at 1, so we still close with the `checkpoint_on_detach` action instead of through the destructor.
- This relies on `shared_ptr` decrements being acq_rel even when they don't reach zero. That holds for all three standard libraries DuckDB builds with (libstdc++, libc++, MSVC STL). An acquire fence would also work, but TSan doesn't model fences.

The added test has a thread take a reference, read the catalog and drop it, then runs DETACH. Without the fix it fails under TSan on every run.
title: Synchronize with dropped references before closing a detached database
